name: round-summary
title: Round Summary
description: The moment a round ends: what the player earned, where today's goal stands, the streak it kept, and anything new they reached (a milestone, a level). Then the next step, which the app passes as children: share, play on, come back tomorrow. It celebrates…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/round-summary

Installed to `components/ui/games/round-summary.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/round-summary';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/round-summary

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
